title: Sweat and Soap
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Asako Yaeshima, a timid office worker at toiletry maker Lilia Drop, is self-conscious about her sweat and smell. The company's lead product developer, Kotaro Natori, loves her scent and finds her inspiring; working together on products, they move from awkward sniffing scenes into a romantic relationship between adults.
life_message: It holds up accepting one's body and being loved as one is, in a caring adult relationship.
